label.explanation: The translation API (api.translate.example) started responding slowly (lines 149, 150, 154) and then hanging until catalog-svc's 30s timeout, which made search-api's calls to catalog-svc time out too (lines 160, 161, 177, 178, 194, 195). Pool saturation in search-api (lines 191, 201, 206, 213, 221) is resource_exhaustion but secondary, and the web-bff 503s (lines 192, 200, 203, 214, 216, 227, 231, 235, 238, 240, 244, 246) are the paging symptom. external_outage is defensible since the third party is degraded, but the observable failure is hanging calls, so dependency_timeout is the best label. Red herrings: line 137 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended); line 153 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 47 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 73 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out).
